title: Emergency lighting and fire alarm
summary: Emergency lighting and fire detection designed, installed and commissioned to Irish standards.
body: We design to the escape route, not the catalogue. Photometric layouts show the maintained illuminance on the actual route; detection zoning follows the building's compartmentation. Commissioning includes a full duration test and a signed certificate.
deliverables: Detection zoning drawing agreed with the fire officer
Installation, commissioning and full duration test
